title: Pairs of commuting isometries via new core operator
summary: We study commuting isometric pairs $(V_1,V_2)$ that admit a factorization of the form $(V_2V_3,\,V_2)$ for some isometry $V_3$. To investigate this class, we introduce the notion of core operator associated with a commuting isometric pair $(V_1, V_2):$ \begin{equation*} H(V_1, V_2):=V_2V_2^*-V_1V_1^*-V_2^2V_2^{*2}+V_1V_2V_1^*V_2^*. \end{equation*} This core operator is closely associated with the domain Hartogs triangle.
